purpose: Package the v18 B Wide128 checkpoint behind a deployment-computable coefficient-space radial high-band guard, without retraining or changing weights.
method_change: Apply the existing project_low_mid_increment operator to the 16 scaled DSCP coefficient maps before temporal-basis materialization. The projection uses the exact normalized 2-D radial high-band mask of the paper confirmatory metric.
weight_change: none; exact v18 B_data_hinge model_state is loaded
deployment_inputs: unchanged v18/DSCP inputs only: velocity, source map, travel time, coordinates, two observed frames, parent wavefield, k0/k1; no future truth or family label

evidence_boundary.confirmed_train_only: v19 B off-panel consistent; v20b guarded post-hoc 24/24 radial-high nonworse, joint gain 0.0265359, maximum guard high-energy fraction 1.91e-12, coefficient projection mean latency about 0.60 ms
evidence_boundary.not_yet_confirmed: validation/test_id generalization and paper-level held-out dispersion claim
evidence_boundary.sealed_validation: must not be opened without explicit lead authorization and a separate frozen validation-once preregistration

prohibitions: no generalization or dispersion-suppression paper claim from train-only evidence
